text: Debugging is an essential skill for any programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs by observing the symptoms and finding where the problem occurs. Fortunately, modern debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, make this process much easier. However, successful debugging also requires a systematic approach. Instead of changing code randomly, you should form a clear hypothesis, test it, and narrow down the cause. In addition, logging is a simple but powerful technique. By adding log messages to your code, you can track what happens at runtime and spot errors quickly. With patience and good strategies, you can solve problems efficiently.
